memory_before.harborpass/support-replay-release-1-0-ru: HarborPass support_replay (case IOS-1842, issue trial-gl1) is pinned to the approved customer-facing release 1.0 notice rules: send_on = renewal_on minus 21 calendar days; credit only when autopay is true AND completed_years >= 2; credit = floor(plan_cents / 10) capped at 2400 cents, else 0; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents; customer_id copied unchanged. Implemented in main.py release_1_0_notice(), which notice() currently delegates to. Later issues may change the customer-facing notice command, but release_1_0_notice() must stay fixed so support replays keep returning release 1.0 values.

memory_after.harborpass/notice-export-policy: HarborPass notice/export policy standing agreement: since trial-005 (2026-09-07), every notice and export request uses the revised retention policy — send_on is 14 calendar days before renewal_on; completed_years >= 3 earns credit_cents = min(floor(plan_cents * 15 / 100), 3600), else 0; autopay does not affect eligibility; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents. Source of truth: trial-005 issue text and release/retention functions in main.py. support_replay remains pinned to the historical release 1.0 rules (21-day lead, autopay AND completed_years >= 2 for min(plan_cents // 10, 2400)) via release_1_0_notice. Public fixture status after trial-005: public_tests/stage_1.json and stage_2.json are OBSOLETE for notice/export (they encode the superseded release 1.0 expectations and will fail by design); stage_3.json (support_replay) and stage_4.json (revised retention) are the valid fixtures. Do not revert the retention policy to make stage_1/stage_2 pass; README documents that earlier-stage examples become obsolete when a later issue changes requirements.
